# Engineering commands

The default selection is the core package. Optional packages are explicit choices; their presence here does not establish installation or authorize adding them.

## Core, in lifecycle order (`qs-skills`)

- [qs-help](./qs-help/SKILL.md) — Find the right QuickStark skill or workflow.
- [qs-setup](./qs-setup/SKILL.md) — Configure project trackers, labels, and docs.
- [qs-plan-clarify](./qs-plan-clarify/SKILL.md) — Clarify a plan and capture durable decisions.
- [qs-plan-roadmap](./qs-plan-roadmap/SKILL.md) — Map large projects into manageable decisions.
- [qs-plan-spec](./qs-plan-spec/SKILL.md) — Turn agreed requirements into a spec or tickets.
- [qs-code-build](./qs-code-build/SKILL.md) — Implement a specification or tracked ticket.
- [qs-code-debug](./qs-code-debug/SKILL.md) — Reproduce and diagnose a bug or regression.
- [qs-review-code](./qs-review-code/SKILL.md) — Review, improve, or refactor selected code safely.
- [qs-git-merge](./qs-git-merge/SKILL.md) — Safely integrate and publish verified GitHub changes.
- [qs-deploy-release](./qs-deploy-release/SKILL.md) — Safely verify and run a documented deployment.
- [qs-flow-triage](./qs-flow-triage/SKILL.md) — Triage incoming issues into actionable work.

## Optional specialists (`qs-specialists`)

- [qs-plan-research](./qs-plan-research/SKILL.md) — Research a question using reliable sources.
- [qs-design-prototype](./qs-design-prototype/SKILL.md) — Prototype an interface or design decision.
- [qs-code-document](./qs-code-document/SKILL.md) — Write accurate, verified project documentation.
- [qs-test-author](./qs-test-author/SKILL.md) — Add focused tests for existing behavior.
- [qs-test-verify](./qs-test-verify/SKILL.md) — Run and report selected software verification.
- [qs-deploy-prompt](./qs-deploy-prompt/SKILL.md) — Generate a scoped autonomous deployment prompt.

## Optional advanced workflows (`qs-advanced`)

- [qs-how](./qs-how/SKILL.md) — Explain how a selected subsystem works.
- [qs-why](./qs-why/SKILL.md) — Explain why a behavior or design exists.
- [qs-blast-radius](./qs-blast-radius/SKILL.md) — Map the impact of one proposed change.
- [qs-runtime-forensics](./qs-runtime-forensics/SKILL.md) — Diagnose one live runtime symptom.
- [qs-trace-forensics](./qs-trace-forensics/SKILL.md) — Diagnose one supplied trace artifact.
- [qs-create-verification-skill](./qs-create-verification-skill/SKILL.md) — Create a rerunnable verification workflow.
- [qs-maintain-verification-skill](./qs-maintain-verification-skill/SKILL.md) — Reconcile a verification workflow with reality.
- [qs-skill-eval](./qs-skill-eval/SKILL.md) — Compare skill variants through blinded trials.
- [qs-hillclimb](./qs-hillclimb/SKILL.md) — Improve one metric through bounded experiments.
- [qs-visual-parity](./qs-visual-parity/SKILL.md) — Converge toward a verified visual baseline.
- [qs-pr-babysit](./qs-pr-babysit/SKILL.md) — Drive one PR toward merge readiness.
- [qs-worktree-cleanup](./qs-worktree-cleanup/SKILL.md) — Audit and remove confirmed worktrees.

## Optional frontend workflows (`qs-frontend`)

- [qs-design-frontend](./qs-design-frontend/SKILL.md) — Build or revise a frontend within its existing constraints.
- [qs-design-image-web](./qs-design-image-web/SKILL.md) — Create web design images or reusable design prompts.
- [qs-design-image-mobile](./qs-design-image-mobile/SKILL.md) — Create platform-aware mobile images or design prompts.
- [qs-design-image-to-code](./qs-design-image-to-code/SKILL.md) — Implement a selected design reference as responsive code.

## Optional execution workflow (`qs-execution`)

- [qs-unlazy](./qs-unlazy/SKILL.md) — Complete substantial work against explicit acceptance gates.

Private capabilities and bundled modules support these roots. They are not commands or additional picker entries. Historical PS identities are documented only in the [migration guide](../../docs/pstack/index.md).

See [skill provenance](../../docs/upstream/provenance.md) for original sources, reviewed and adopted revisions, and attribution.
